problems.reason: Both sentences state the taxonomic placement of the dinosaur, repeating the claim that it belongs to the family/subfamily Stegosauridae.
Sentences 15, 17, and 18 give conflicting classifications: 15 places it in Stegosauridae, 17 moves it to Huayangosauridae, and 18 associates it with the subfamily Kentrosaurinae.
Sentence 20 dates the species to the Oxfordian stage (~156 Ma), while sentence 21 claims its habitat spanned the Bathonian to Callovian stages (168.2–161.5 Ma), which are earlier than the Oxfordian.

notes: - contradiction: "The broader family group for this dinosaur is Stegosauridae." / "In 2008, Maidment and colleagues moved the animal into the family Huayangosauridae." / "The shape of its skin armor links it to relatives like Kentrosaurus and Dacentrurus in the subfamily Kentrosaurinae.": Sentences 15, 17, and 18 give conflicting classifications: 15 places it in Stegosauridae, 17 moves it to Huayangosauridae, and 18 associates it with the subfamily Kentrosaurinae.

- contradiction: "This creature lived during the Oxfordian stage of the Late Jurassic, about 156 million years ago." / "Its habitat spanned the Bathonian to Callovian stages, ranging from 168.2 to 161.5 million years ago.": Sentence 20 dates the species to the Oxfordian stage (~156 Ma), while sentence 21 claims its habitat spanned the Bathonian to Callovian stages (168.2–161.5 Ma), which are earlier than the Oxfordian.
